After: apply afterOwnedProductionCorrections in listed order, taking file bytes or deletions from their recorded commits. Both: take sharedOwnedIntegrationOverlay and sharedFinalTestsAndMeasurementTools bytes from their commits. After alone takes afterOwnedIntegrationOverlay. The previous incomplete ABBA attempt and warmup failure are retained separately; final ABBA uses both rebuilt artifacts with this correction. Finally overlay sharedFinalHarnessFailureOverlay paths from its commit into BOTH roots. This failure-preservation change leaves successful timers/playback assertions and staged renderer/runtime bytes unchanged.
